name: Annie Vandevanter
occurrence_1: Paxson list p.92 (img 269): 'Feb.4,1869  Annie Vandevanter  age 16 yrs.  Consumption'
occurrence_2: Washingtonian p.104 (img 281), issue 26 Feb 1869: 'Died on 9th inst. Annie, only daughter of Armistead Vandevanter, in 17th year, was Presbyterian'
what_differs: death date (4 vs 9 Feb 1869) and age (16 vs in 17th year)
note: Same person, two independent sources. The ages are compatible (16 completed years = in her 17th year). The dates are not. Paxson often records the BURIAL date, which would put death before 4 Feb and make the newspaper's 9th harder to reconcile; alternatively the paper's '9th inst.' is an error for the 4th. UNRESOLVED. The newspaper adds that she was Presbyterian and the only daughter; Paxson adds the cause, consumption. Paxson also records her father Armstead Vandevander, 56, under the same date of 4 Feb 1869.
